author: WALA KA LABOT
title: App On Lock Screen
content: Yesterday I decided to purchase the PRO version of the app because up until that point I was very impressed with its simplicity and user-friendly atmosphere. But I seem to have a hard time looking for ways on how to have the app show in my lock screen. Sent you multiple emails but I have yet to receive any reply.

author: Zagred
title: Unknowingly connecting to bluetooth devices
content: Whenever i start the car, evermusic automatically play songs even if i dont want to. I tried to remove this bluetooth connection in settings but still evermusic automatically plays in the car bluetooth. Please fix this.

author: binokyo
title: improvements
content: I downloaded the free version and purchased in app to become pro. The app is very promising as if I can let go of my Apple, Youtube and Spotify. Just few things, the songs in a playlist always gone after including it. I mean I have added it hundred times doing troubleshooting because i believe in your app. Nothing happened. So I deleted the app and installed the Pro one even if I have bout in app purchase in the old one. Thinking this should be the perfect one. Sadly there’s the same issue. Song gone inside a playlist. If I have added 27 songs, youll see there comes 20 songs. Then I add, check, add check, and so on. Same problem. I hope you resolve this issue. More power.
